remarks: Experience refined condo living in Chesterfield, one of Stamford's premier condo communities. This beautifully maintained 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence is situated on the 2nd floor and delivers an elevated lifestyle within a gated setting and access to sought-after amenities. Inside, the open-concept layout creates a bright and inviting atmosphere with well-balanced living spaces, beautiful moldings, and recessed lighting. The kitchen is appointed with stainless steel appliances, while the well-maintained bathroom enhances the home's clean, polished feel. In-unit laundry with a new washer and dryer adds an extra level of everyday ease. Enjoy your own private deck and take advantage of community amenities including a pool and unassigned parking for up to 2 cars. With exceptional walkability, this residence places shopping, dining, commuter bus lines, public transportation, medical facilities, parks, recreation, golf, health clubs, and other everyday destinations within easy reach. A move-in-ready opportunity that brings together style, comfort, and an exceptional Stamford location.
